messages:
lucy: Opening PR to update SDK snippets: change streaming to chunked iterator, rename page_token -> cursor in examples, and add a short migration checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4988

dan: can you include a tiny translation table in the migration note? e.g. page_token -> cursor, .streaming() -> .stream(), full_response -> delta chunks. That helps support scripts.

omar: good idea. Also the examples-checker flagged a fenced code formatting lint on one py snippet (triple backticks inside a single-line docstring). I pushed a fix to use raw-code block instead.

lucy: copying the migration checklist I'm adding: 1) switch page_token params to cursor 2) update streaming samples to iterate chunks and assemble text 3) add ctx cancel in Go samples 4) add resume token pattern for interrupted streams 5) include small backoff util for 5xx.

dan: sample Python assembly to include in doc:```py
parts = []
async for ev in client.stream(req):
    if ev.type == 'delta':
        parts.append(ev.text)
result = ''.join(parts)
```
callout: mention older convenience snippet is kept under "compat" subsection.

omar: Go reminder: show context timeout and handle io.EOF + transient err with backoff. I'll push a tiny helper.

ci-bot: PR opened: docs#4988 reviewers requested: @dan @omar. CI: docs-lint/examples-sanity queued.

support-bot: after merge please notify support to update runbooks (streaming resume pattern + cursor rename).

lucy: thanks all. I'll merge after green CI and then add a short line in breaking-changes.md. Ping here if you spot any remaining page_token or .streaming uses.
